The Spaces list is open. It's a "My spaces" sheet with All chats and three "Benchmark HQ" entries.

I found the control by reading the app's accessibility tree, then tapped the "My spaces" button in the bottom toolbar. Simulator taps aren't exposed through `simctl`, so I used a small XCUITest runner in `uitest/` under the temp folder. I haven't selected a space or changed anything else.
